description: This file implements the BytezChatConfig class, a configuration class for interfacing with Bytez's API for language models. It also includes classes for streaming responses, utility functions to adapt message formats, and methods for handling API requests and responses related to chat models.

classes.name: BytezChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Bytez's API interface, inherits from BaseConfig, managing parameters and environment validation for API calls.

classes.name: BytezCustomStreamWrapper
classes.description: A custom stream wrapper class for handling streaming responses from Bytez's API, extends CustomStreamWrapper, processes individual chunks.

methods.description: Adapts a dictionary of parameters to Bytez's expected parameter naming, with options to drop unsupported params.

methods.description: Validates and prepares headers and environment settings before making API calls.

methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for a given model and base.
